messages.author: Shreeramesh
messages.body:
Dear AMBER users,
I am not able to run PARTIAL MINIMIZATION STEP in AMBER 14 and AMBER 18. It
is giving the following error. I keep all the necessary files (*.crd,
.top, .in*, .pbs) in my working directory and I also attached those files
in the attachment for your kind attention. I request you to kindly help me
to fix this error.
Error:
-bash: /var/spool/PBS/mom_priv/jobs/2891383.sched01.SC: /bin/bash^M: bad
interpreter: No such file or directory
*Thanks & Regards*
*Ramesh M*
Email: shreeramesh.gmail.com Mob.: +91-9542200332

messages.author: Elvis Martis
messages.body:

>: /bin/bash^M: bad
interpreter: No such file or directory

with windows notepad or wordpad.
Please rewrite or ask your admin to provide you a new pbs script.
Best Regards
Elvis
